traps.description: profile-svc v1.8.0 shipped 30 minutes earlier with a new avatar renderer, a nil-pointer panic in that renderer appears, and a past incident blames a renderer release; but v1.8.0 served cleanly for 30 minutes, the panic follows the avatar-store timeouts, and feed-svc (not deployed) fails against avatar-store too
profile-svc pods restart and fail liveness, which looks like profile-svc itself is broken; the restarts happen because its handlers block on avatar-store
avatar-store's shallow health check stays green, which seems to clear it; its request success rate tells the opposite story
